Let me analyze the teaching examples more carefully to identify the systematic forecast errors and correction rules.

Looking at Example 1 (2024-09-11):
- History: prices declining from 72.52 → 64.92 over 18 days
- Model forecast: starts at 66.33, then slowly declines
- True outcomes: starts at 66.40, then declines faster
